title: Reject duplicate labels and invalid memberships
preconditions: A fresh Saga has a feature assigned to a label named Platform operations; save its plan bytes.

steps.action: Attempt to create a label named platform operations.
steps.expected_result: The case-insensitive duplicate name is rejected.

steps.action: Attempt missing and cross-Saga label assignments; compare plan bytes.
steps.expected_result: Both writes fail without changing the plan.

steps.action: Inspect the duplicate-name error from the preceding request.
steps.expected_result: The diagnostic identifies the existing definition.

expected_result: Reject duplicate labels and invalid memberships.
